description: Airborne IRST scenario for v3.6.16 — moving ownship at 3000m altitude with sustained right turn (per Fogel-Gavish 1988 observability theorem, sensor motion must out-maneuver target motion by ≥1 order). Replaces test_IRST.json's observability-limited stationary geometry (Tracked% 0% per MathWorks 'Passive Ranging Using a Single Maneuvering Sensor' — the original test_IRST remains untouched for v3.6.15 evidence preservation). End-to-end pipeline: loadRunFile.m §7 routes ownship via trackbench.scenario.addOwnshipFromDef (behavior='waypoints') → waypointTrajectory with AutoBank=AutoPitch=true (fixed-wing aircraft per R2025b Algorithms truth table) → airborne_IRST.json (MechanicalScanLimits widened to [[0,360],[-15,25]] to accommodate body-frame elevation rotation under bank) → runDetections.m (si.isIR branch at line 162, 2-vec minMeas branch at line 401, v3.7.0 defensive weather guards at lines 488/506) → trackbenchFilterInit angle-only wrapper (initrpekf → trackingGSF for 2-vec [az;el] measurements with struct-array MeasurementParameters per v3.7.0) → trackerGNN with lenient confirmation (test_IRST_GNN) → v3.7.2 world-frame truth log (platformPoses-based, BUGHUNT v3.7.2 fix). Ownship trajectory: CV-north at 200 m/s for 0-15s (initial bearing-only collection), sustained right turn 15-40s (heading rotates 0° → ~85°), CV-ENE 40-50s. Target: non-maneuvering CV south at 150 m/s, starting NE of ownship at 2800m alt — kept in body-frame elevation envelope through the maneuver. Clear-air scenario (terrain_occlusion=false, horizon_masking=false) to keep v3.7.x site 3 (per-sensor visibility-masking targetPoses plat-local-frame, X-F6 deferred to potential v3.7.3) dormant for demo-day. EXPECTED CONSOLE SIGNATURE: '[RUN] Platform "ownship": 1 sensor(s) — MOVING (behavior=waypoints)', 'Primary sensors: 1 | Beacon sensors: 0', per-scan 'Primary=N, Beacon=0, total=N (clutter=0)' lines, ≥1 confirmed track. SUCCESS GATE for Phase 3 verification: (a) end-to-end run without error, (b) ≥1 confirmed track, (c) Tracked% > 0% on truth target — validates v3.7.2 truth-log frame fix AND v3.6.16 addOwnshipFromDef integration AND airborne_IRST envelope geometry. REGRESSION PAIR: run alongside test_IRST.json (untouched) to confirm v3.6.15 ground-based IRST evidence still reproducible.
